blocks.zh: §820.4：品質管理系統要求與 ISO 13485 整合
blocks.en: §820.4: Quality Management System Requirements and Integration with ISO 13485

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解「納入參考（incorporation by reference）」的法律意義——ISO 13485:2016 對美國醫療器材製造商具有法規強制力
blocks.en: Understand the legal significance of "incorporation by reference": ISO 13485:2016 is legally enforceable for US medical device manufacturers

blocks.zh: 識別 FDA 附錄 A（Appendix A）中的 FDA 專屬要求：這些是 ISO 13485 認證企業可能遺漏的額外義務
blocks.en: Identify the FDA-specific requirements in Appendix A: additional obligations that ISO 13485-certified companies may overlook

blocks.zh: 針對 CDMO 情境：若公司已持有 ISO 13485 認證，評估需補充哪些步驟才符合 QMSR 要求
blocks.en: For the CDMO scenario: if your company already holds ISO 13485 certification, assess which additional steps are needed to meet QMSR requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — §820.4 核心規定
blocks.en: Commentary — §820.4 Core Provisions

blocks.zh: QMSR 的核心架構一句話
blocks.en: The Core Architecture of the QMSR in One Sentence

blocks.zh: §820.4 的邏輯非常簡潔：「你必須建立符合 ISO 13485:2016 的 QMS，並額外滿足 Appendix A 的 FDA 專屬要求。」這就是整個 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR 的主軸。
blocks.en: The logic of §820.4 is very simple: "You must establish a QMS that conforms to ISO 13485:2016 and also meet the FDA-specific requirements in Appendix A." This is the backbone of the entire 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR.

blocks.zh: 舊版 QSR（Quality System Regulation，2002年版）直接列出詳細要求；新版 QMSR（2022年最終規則，2026年2月2日生效）改採「納入參考」方式，將 ISO 13485 整體引入聯邦法規。
blocks.en: The former QSR (Quality System Regulation, 2002 edition) listed detailed requirements directly. The new QMSR (final rule issued 2022, effective February 2, 2026) instead uses "incorporation by reference" to bring ISO 13485 into the federal regulations as a whole.

blocks.zh: 「納入參考」（Incorporation by Reference）是什麼？
blocks.en: What Is "Incorporation by Reference"?

blocks.zh: 簡單說：FDA 把 ISO 13485:2016 這份文件「印進」了美國聯邦法規裡。從法律角度，它跟直接在 CFR 裡逐條列出要求的效果完全一樣。
blocks.en: Put simply: FDA has "printed" the ISO 13485:2016 document into the US federal regulations. Legally, it has exactly the same effect as listing the requirements clause by clause directly in the CFR.

blocks.zh: 實務含義：
blocks.en: Practical implications:

blocks.zh: 若公司未遵循 ISO 13485:2016，即違反 21 CFR Part 820 聯邦法規，可能面臨 FDA Warning Letter、進口禁令或設備扣押
blocks.en: A company that does not follow ISO 13485:2016 violates the federal regulation 21 CFR Part 820 and may face an FDA Warning Letter, an import ban, or seizure of devices

blocks.zh: 法院裁判、FDA 483 觀察項目、或 Warning Letter 均可引用 ISO 13485 的具體條款作為違規依據
blocks.en: Court decisions, FDA 483 observations, or Warning Letters can all cite specific clauses of ISO 13485 as the basis for a violation

blocks.zh: 必須使用被引用的特定版本（ISO 13485:2016），即使 ISO 後來發布了更新版本
blocks.en: The specific version referenced (ISO 13485:2016) must be used, even if ISO later publishes an updated version

blocks.zh: 比喻：標準公路法規 + 州法附加規定
blocks.en: Analogy: Standard Highway Rules plus State-Specific Additions

blocks.zh: 想像 ISO 13485:2016 是聯邦公路交通法規，適用於所有人；Appendix A 則是加州（= FDA）對在加州境內行駛車輛的額外規定（如特殊排放標準）。兩套規定都必須遵守，且當兩者衝突時，加州法規優先。
blocks.en: Imagine ISO 13485:2016 as the federal highway traffic code, which applies to everyone. Appendix A is California's (= FDA's) additional rules for vehicles driving within California (such as special emission standards). Both sets of rules must be followed, and where the two conflict, the California rules take precedence.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：你同時服務「高速公路上的所有客戶」（ISO 13485 客戶）和「進入加州的客戶」（美國上市產品）——後者需要同時符合兩套規定。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, you serve both "all customers on the highway" (ISO 13485 customers) and "customers entering California" (products marketed in the US). The latter must comply with both sets of rules.

blocks.zh: 重要：使用哪個版本的 ISO 13485？
blocks.en: Important: Which Version of ISO 13485 Applies?

blocks.zh: 必須使用 ISO 13485:2016（第三版，2016年3月1日發布）。若 ISO 在未來發布 ISO 13485:2026 或更新版，在 FDA 修訂 §820.1(b) 引用版本之前，FDA 要求的法定版本仍是 2016 版。這個「版本凍結」特性在 QMSR 實施初期尤其需要注意。
blocks.en: You must use ISO 13485:2016 (3rd edition, published March 1, 2016). If ISO publishes ISO 13485:2026 or a later version in the future, the legally required version for FDA remains the 2016 edition until FDA amends the version cited in §820.1(b). This "version freeze" feature deserves particular attention in the early period of QMSR implementation.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — ISO 13485 §4–6 精解
blocks.en: Commentary — ISO 13485 §4–6 in Detail

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §4–6 在 QMS 架構中的位置
blocks.en: Where ISO 13485 §4–6 Sit in the QMS Architecture

blocks.zh: 整個 ISO 13485:2016 共 8 個章節，結構如下：
blocks.en: ISO 13485:2016 as a whole has 8 clauses, structured as follows:

blocks.zh: §1–3：範圍、術語定義（非要求）
blocks.en: §1–3: Scope, normative references, terms and definitions (not requirements)

blocks.zh: §4：QMS 基礎架構（本節重點：文件與記錄控制）
blocks.en: §4: QMS foundation (focus of this section: document and record control)

blocks.zh: §5：管理責任（本節重點：高層承諾、品質政策、管理審查）
blocks.en: §5: Management responsibility (focus of this section: top management commitment, quality policy, management review)

blocks.zh: §6：資源管理（本節重點：人員、設施、工作環境）
blocks.en: §6: Resource management (focus of this section: personnel, facilities, work environment)

blocks.zh: §7：產品實現（設計開發、採購、生產）
blocks.en: §7: Product realization (design and development, purchasing, production)

blocks.zh: §8：量測、分析與改善（CAPA、內部稽核）
blocks.en: §8: Measurement, analysis and improvement (CAPA, internal audit)

blocks.zh: §4–6 構成 QMS 的「基礎建設」，§7–8 是在此基礎上運作的「執行層」。
blocks.en: §4–6 form the "infrastructure" of the QMS, while §7–8 are the "execution layer" operating on top of that foundation.

blocks.zh: §4.2 文件體系的四個層次
blocks.en: The Four Tiers of the §4.2 Documentation System

blocks.zh: 一個完整的 ISO 13485 文件體系通常分為四層：
blocks.en: A complete ISO 13485 documentation system is usually divided into four tiers:

blocks.zh: 第一層：品質手冊（QM） — 描述 QMS 全貌，通常對外公開
blocks.en: Tier 1: Quality Manual (QM) — describes the whole QMS and is usually made available externally

blocks.zh: 第二層：程序書（SOP/QP） — 描述跨部門流程，「做什麼、誰來做」
blocks.en: Tier 2: Procedures (SOP/QP) — describe cross-functional processes: "what to do and who does it"

blocks.zh: 第三層：作業指導書（WI/SWI） — 描述操作細節，「如何做」
blocks.en: Tier 3: Work instructions (WI/SWI) — describe operating details: "how to do it"

blocks.zh: 第四層：表單與記錄 — 執行結果的書面證據
blocks.en: Tier 4: Forms and records — written evidence of the results of execution

blocks.zh: 文件（Documents，第1–3層）與記錄（Records，第4層）的管控要求不同——文件需要版本控制、審批、發行管理；記錄需要保存期限管理。
blocks.en: Documents (Tiers 1–3) and records (Tier 4) have different control requirements: documents need version control, approval, and issuance control; records need retention period management.

blocks.zh: 比喻：管理審查就像強制議程的董事會季報
blocks.en: Analogy: Management Review Is Like a Board's Quarterly Report with a Mandatory Agenda

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §5.6 的管理審查不是「老闆想開就開、想談什麼就談什麼」的會議。它比較像上市公司的董事會季報：
blocks.en: The management review in ISO 13485 §5.6 is not a meeting that the boss convenes whenever they like and fills with whatever they want to discuss. It is more like the quarterly report to the board of a listed company:

blocks.zh: 強制議程（輸入）：投訴、不符合事項、CAPA 狀態、稽核結果、法規反饋、流程績效指標——這些都必須被報告，不能跳過
blocks.en: Mandatory agenda (inputs): complaints, nonconformities, CAPA status, audit results, regulatory feedback, process performance indicators. All of these must be reported and none can be skipped

blocks.zh: 強制產出（輸出）：資源決策、改善行動、品質目標更新——必須形成具體決議並有記錄
blocks.en: Mandatory outcomes (outputs): resource decisions, improvement actions, updated quality objectives. These must be turned into concrete decisions and recorded

blocks.zh: 法規意義：FDA 稽查官員在查廠時會直接要求查閱管理審查記錄，確認高層是否真正參與 QMS
blocks.en: Regulatory significance: during an inspection, FDA investigators will directly ask to see the management review records to confirm that top management is genuinely involved in the QMS

blocks.zh: 沒有完整輸入/輸出記錄的管理審查，在 FDA 看來等同於「沒有開過」。
blocks.en: In FDA's eyes, a management review without complete input and output records is the same as one that was "never held."

blocks.zh: §6.2 人員能力管理的四步驟
blocks.en: The Four Steps of Personnel Competence Management under §6.2

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §6.2 要求一個清晰的能力管理循環：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §6.2 requires a clear competence management cycle:

blocks.zh: Determine（確定需求）：識別影響品質的崗位，列出所需能力
blocks.en: Determine (determine needs): identify the positions that affect quality and list the competence required

blocks.zh: Provide（提供訓練）：設計培訓計畫或採取其他行動
blocks.en: Provide (provide training): design a training plan or take other actions

blocks.zh: Evaluate（評估有效性）：確認培訓是否真的提升能力（不只是完成出席簽到）
blocks.en: Evaluate (evaluate effectiveness): confirm that training has actually improved competence (not just that attendance sheets were signed)

blocks.zh: Maintain records（保存記錄）：教育背景、培訓記錄、技能、經驗
blocks.en: Maintain records: education, training records, skills, and experience

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見缺陷：只有培訓完成記錄，沒有有效性評估（如測驗成績、考核記錄），導致 FDA 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: Common CDMO deficiency: having only training completion records and no effectiveness evaluation (such as test scores or assessment records), which leads to FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: §6.4 工作環境與污染控制——無菌製造特別注意
blocks.en: §6.4 Work Environment and Contamination Control: Special Attention for Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 對無菌醫療器材 CDMO，§6.4 的工作環境要求與設施設計直接掛鉤：
blocks.en: For a sterile medical device CDMO, the work environment requirements of §6.4 are directly tied to facility design:

blocks.zh: 必須有書面的環境規格（溫度、濕度、微粒、微生物限度）
blocks.en: There must be written environmental specifications (temperature, humidity, particulates, microbial limits)

blocks.zh: 若人員接觸產品可能影響品質，必須有書面的著裝、健康狀況規定
blocks.en: If contact between personnel and product could affect quality, there must be written requirements for clothing and health status

blocks.zh: 污染品或潛在污染品的隔離程序必須文件化，防止交叉污染
blocks.en: Procedures for segregating contaminated or potentially contaminated product must be documented to prevent cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 這些要求與 FDA 2004 無菌指引的設施要求形成交叉——QMSR §820.4 + ISO 13485 §6.4 是其法規根據。
blocks.en: These requirements overlap with the facility requirements of the 2004 FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance; QMSR §820.4 + ISO 13485 §6.4 are their regulatory basis.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 文件控制與記錄保存
blocks.en: Commentary — Document Control and Record Retention

blocks.zh: 版本控制七要素（§4.2.4 管制文件程序必備）
blocks.en: Seven Elements of Document Control (Required in the §4.2.4 Document Control Procedure)

blocks.zh: 一份符合 ISO 13485 §4.2.4 的文件管控程序，必須涵蓋以下七個控制點：
blocks.en: A document control procedure that meets ISO 13485 §4.2.4 must cover the following seven control points:

blocks.zh: 核准（Approval）：發行前需由授權人審核簽核
blocks.en: Approval: documents must be reviewed and signed off by an authorized person before issue

blocks.zh: 審查與更新（Review & Update）：定期審查，必要時修訂並重新核准
blocks.en: Review & Update: review periodically and, where necessary, revise and re-approve

blocks.zh: 版次識別（Revision Status）：明確標示版本號、生效日期，變更摘要
blocks.en: Revision Status: clearly indicate the version number, effective date, and a summary of changes

blocks.zh: 現行版本可取得性（Currency at Point of Use）：使用點只有最新版可用
blocks.en: Currency at Point of Use: only the latest version is available at the point of use

blocks.zh: 易讀性（Legibility）：文件清晰、可識別、不得模糊
blocks.en: Legibility: documents must be clear and identifiable, and must not be blurred

blocks.zh: 外部文件識別（External Documents）：客戶規格、法規要求、標準等需識別並管控發行
blocks.en: External Documents: customer specifications, regulatory requirements, standards, etc. must be identified and their distribution controlled

blocks.zh: 廢止文件管理（Obsolete Documents）：舊版需隔離或明確標記「作廢」，防止誤用
blocks.en: Obsolete Documents: old versions must be segregated or clearly marked "obsolete" to prevent unintended use

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限計算公式
blocks.en: Formula for Calculating the Record Retention Period

blocks.zh: FDA QMSR 要求：
blocks.en: FDA QMSR requirement:

blocks.zh:
保存期限 = MAX(產品預期使用壽命 + 2年, 最終出廠日期 + 2年)

實際例子：
• 一次性注射器（預期壽命 = 1次使用，合理使用期 ~3年）
  → 出廠日起至少保存 2 年
• 可重複使用外科器械（預期壽命 10 年）
  → 出廠日起保存 12 年（10 + 2）
• 心臟瓣膜植入物（預期壽命 20 年）
  → 出廠日起保存 22 年（20 + 2）
blocks.en:
Retention period = MAX(expected device lifetime + 2 years, date of final release + 2 years)

Practical examples:
• Single-use syringe (expected lifetime = 1 use, reasonable shelf life ~3 years)
  → retain at least 2 years from the release date
• Reusable surgical instrument (expected lifetime 10 years)
  → retain 12 years from the release date (10 + 2)
• Heart valve implant (expected lifetime 20 years)
  → retain 22 years from the release date (20 + 2)

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §4.2.5 基準線：製造商定義的產品壽命期間，但最少 2 年（從產品放行日起）
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §4.2.5 baseline: the product lifetime defined by the manufacturer, but at least 2 years (from the date of product release)

blocks.zh: 結論：FDA 要求通常等於或嚴於 ISO 13485。以 FDA 要求為準。
blocks.en: Conclusion: FDA requirements are usually equal to or stricter than ISO 13485. Follow the FDA requirement.

blocks.zh: 分發管控（Distribution Control）實務
blocks.en: Distribution Control in Practice

blocks.zh: SOP 的分發管控在紙本和電子系統中有不同挑戰：
blocks.en: Distribution control of SOPs presents different challenges in paper and electronic systems:

blocks.zh: 電子 QMS（eQMS）：系統自動確保各使用點只能存取現行版，廢止版本自動鎖定——較易符合要求
blocks.en: Electronic QMS (eQMS): the system automatically ensures that each point of use can access only the current version, and obsolete versions are locked automatically, which makes compliance easier

blocks.zh: 紙本分發：需維護分發清冊（Distribution List），追蹤哪些人/部門持有哪個版本；版本更新時需回收舊版或確認銷毀
blocks.en: Paper distribution: a distribution list must be maintained to track which persons/departments hold which version; when a version is updated, the old copies must be retrieved or their destruction confirmed

blocks.zh: 外部文件（客戶規格/標準）：需有機制監控客戶規格是否更新，確保使用最新版本
blocks.en: External documents (customer specifications/standards): a mechanism is needed to monitor whether customer specifications have been updated, so that the latest version is always used

blocks.zh: 常見 FDA 483 觀察項——文件控制
blocks.en: Common FDA 483 Observations: Document Control

blocks.zh: 生產現場使用非現行版本的作業指導書（最常見）
blocks.en: Work instructions that are not the current version are used on the production floor (most common)

blocks.zh: 文件審查與核准權限未明確定義
blocks.en: Authority for document review and approval is not clearly defined

blocks.zh: 電子記錄系統無完整稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）——涉及 21 CFR Part 11
blocks.en: Electronic record systems lack a complete audit trail (relevant to 21 CFR Part 11)

blocks.zh: 廢止文件與現行文件存放在同一位置，未有效隔離
blocks.en: Obsolete and current documents are stored in the same location without effective segregation

blocks.zh: 外部文件（如客戶圖面）未納入管控系統
blocks.en: External documents (such as customer drawings) are not included in the control system

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — Appendix A FDA 專屬要求
blocks.en: Commentary — Appendix A FDA-Specific Requirements

blocks.zh: 重要警示：ISO 13485 認證企業最容易遺漏的五個差距
blocks.en: Important Warning: The Five Gaps ISO 13485-Certified Companies Most Often Miss

blocks.zh: 若公司已持有 ISO 13485:2016 認證，但尚未評估 QMSR 合規性，以下是最常見的合規缺口：
blocks.en: If your company already holds ISO 13485:2016 certification but has not yet assessed QMSR compliance, the following are the most common compliance gaps:

blocks.zh: 設計控制（§7.3）排除不適用：ISO 13485 認證時可能選擇排除設計開發，但 FDA 不接受這項排除。若公司進入美國市場，必須建立設計控制程序。
blocks.en: Design controls (§7.3) excluded as not applicable: at the time of ISO 13485 certification, design and development may have been excluded, but FDA does not accept this exclusion. If the company enters the US market, it must establish design control procedures.

blocks.zh: 投訴處理細節要求：ISO 13485 §8.2.2 的要求較 FDA §820.198 寬鬆，可能缺少「每筆投訴是否需要 MDR 申報」的評估程序。
blocks.en: Detailed complaint-handling requirements: the requirements of ISO 13485 §8.2.2 are less strict than FDA §820.198, and the company may lack a procedure for evaluating "whether each complaint requires an MDR submission."

blocks.zh: MDR 觸發機制：QMS 程序中可能沒有自動連結 ISO 13485 不符合事項處理（§8.5）到 21 CFR Part 803 MDR 申報評估的觸發點。
blocks.en: MDR trigger mechanism: QMS procedures may have no automatic link from ISO 13485 nonconformity handling (§8.5) to the trigger point for evaluating 21 CFR Part 803 MDR reporting.

blocks.zh: 英文記錄可取得性：非英語系國家公司的 QMS 記錄若僅有當地語言版本，FDA 查廠時將無法審查。
blocks.en: Availability of English-language records: if the QMS records of a company in a non-English-speaking country exist only in the local language, FDA will be unable to review them during an inspection.

blocks.zh: 召回/矯正措施 Part 806 連結：ISO 13485 §8.5 CAPA 程序可能未包含評估是否需向 FDA 提交 Part 806 矯正移除報告的步驟。
blocks.en: Recall/corrective action link to Part 806: the ISO 13485 §8.5 CAPA procedure may not include a step to assess whether a Part 806 correction and removal report must be submitted to FDA.

blocks.zh: 設計控制為何對 CDMO 如此重要？
blocks.en: Why Are Design Controls So Important for a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO（合同製造組織）的商業模式是「客戶擁有設計，CDMO 負責製造」。在純 ISO 13485 框架下，這類 CDMO 可能選擇排除 §7.3 設計開發要求。
blocks.en: The business model of many CDMOs (contract development and manufacturing organizations) is "the customer owns the design, the CDMO handles manufacturing." Under a pure ISO 13485 framework, such a CDMO may choose to exclude the §7.3 design and development requirements.

blocks.zh: 但在 QMSR 框架下：
blocks.en: But under the QMSR framework:

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 持有美國客戶產品的 Device Master Record（DMR），即使客戶「擁有」設計，CDMO 也可能被視為需要維護設計控制記錄的一方
blocks.en: If the CDMO holds the Device Master Record (DMR) for a product of a US customer, the CDMO may be considered a party that must maintain design control records, even though the customer "owns" the design

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 在製造過程中對設計規格做任何修改或詮釋，設計控制要求即被觸發
blocks.en: If the CDMO makes any change to, or interpretation of, the design specifications during manufacturing, the design control requirements are triggered

blocks.zh: 建議：與客戶在 Quality Agreement 中明確劃分設計控制責任
blocks.en: Recommendation: clearly allocate design control responsibilities with the customer in the Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: §820.198 投訴檔案——最低記錄內容
blocks.en: §820.198 Complaint Files: Minimum Record Content

blocks.zh: 每份投訴記錄至少必須包含：
blocks.en: Each complaint record must contain at least:

blocks.zh: 器材名稱
blocks.en: Device name

blocks.zh: 收到投訴日期
blocks.en: Date the complaint was received

blocks.zh: 任何器材識別碼（UDI、批號、序號）
blocks.en: Any device identification (UDI, lot number, serial number)

blocks.zh: 投訴人姓名、地址（若可取得）
blocks.en: Name and address of the complainant (if available)

blocks.zh: 投訴性質
blocks.en: Nature of the complaint

blocks.zh: 調查日期與調查人員
blocks.en: Date of investigation and the investigator

blocks.zh: 調查結果與採取的矯正措施
blocks.en: Investigation results and corrective actions taken

blocks.zh: 是否提交 MDR 申報（若否，記錄理由）
blocks.en: Whether an MDR was submitted (if not, record the reason)

blocks.zh: 沒有上述欄位的投訴記錄系統，即使符合 ISO 13485，也會被 FDA 483 指出缺失。
blocks.en: A complaint record system without the above fields will draw an FDA 483 observation even if it complies with ISO 13485.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Appendix A 是「FDA 的附加保障條款」
blocks.en: Analogy: Appendix A Is "FDA's Additional Safeguard Clauses"

blocks.zh: 如果 ISO 13485:2016 是一份標準合約，那麼 Appendix A 就是 FDA 要求在美國市場運作的「特殊附加條款」。這些條款反映了 FDA 多年來在 QSR 下積累的監管重點：設計控制（PMA 審查核心）、投訴追蹤（MDR 觸發源）、召回效率（Part 806 快速通報）。
blocks.en: If ISO 13485:2016 is a standard contract, Appendix A is the "special additional clauses" that FDA requires for operating in the US market. These clauses reflect the regulatory priorities FDA has built up over many years under the QSR: design controls (the core of PMA review), complaint tracking (the source of MDR triggers), and recall efficiency (rapid notification under Part 806).

blocks.zh: 從 FDA 的角度，這些不是「額外負擔」，而是美國患者安全保護的最低底線。
blocks.en: From FDA's perspective, these are not an "extra burden" but the minimum baseline for protecting US patient safety.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 新舊法規對照分析
blocks.en: Commentary — Comparison of the Old and New Regulations

blocks.zh: 為什麼要了解新舊 QSR 對照？
blocks.en: Why Understand the Old-versus-New QSR Comparison?

blocks.zh: 許多在美國市場運作多年的器材公司，其 QMS 程序是依舊版 QSR（1996/2002）架構設計的。QMSR 的合規轉換需要：
blocks.en: Many device companies that have operated in the US market for years have designed their QMS procedures around the structure of the former QSR (1996/2002). A compliant transition to the QMSR requires you to:

blocks.zh: 識別舊 QSR 程序對應到 ISO 13485 哪個條款
blocks.en: Identify which ISO 13485 clause each legacy QSR procedure maps to

blocks.zh: 找出 ISO 13485 新增要求（如 §4.2.3 器材檔案、§6.4 工作環境）
blocks.en: Find the new ISO 13485 requirements (such as §4.2.3 medical device file and §6.4 work environment)

blocks.zh: 識別 FDA Appendix A 新增要求（如設計控制不可排除）
blocks.en: Identify the new FDA Appendix A requirements (such as design controls that cannot be excluded)

blocks.zh: 更新 QMS 程序、培訓人員、內部稽核清單
blocks.en: Update QMS procedures, train personnel, and update internal audit checklists

blocks.zh: 最大實質變化：管理審查的強制輸入/輸出
blocks.en: The Biggest Substantive Change: Mandatory Inputs/Outputs of Management Review

blocks.zh: 舊 QSR §820.20(c) 要求「定期進行管理審查並維護記錄」，但未明確規定審查必須涵蓋哪些內容。
blocks.en: Former QSR §820.20(c) required "conducting management reviews at defined intervals and maintaining records," but did not specify what the review must cover.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §5.6 大幅提高要求：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §5.6 raises the requirements considerably:

blocks.zh: 強制輸入（至少需涵蓋）：
blocks.en: Mandatory inputs (at a minimum, must cover):

blocks.zh: 顧客反饋（包含投訴）
blocks.en: Customer feedback (including complaints)

blocks.zh: 向主管機關報告的事項
blocks.en: Reporting to regulatory authorities

blocks.zh: 稽核結果（含內部稽核）
blocks.en: Audit results (including internal audits)

blocks.zh: 流程監測與量測結果
blocks.en: Process monitoring and measurement results

blocks.zh: 產品監測結果
blocks.en: Product monitoring results

blocks.zh: CAPA 狀態
blocks.en: CAPA status

blocks.zh: 上次管理審查的後續行動追蹤
blocks.en: Follow-up actions from previous management reviews

blocks.zh: 可能影響 QMS 的變更
blocks.en: Changes that could affect the QMS

blocks.zh: 改善建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for improvement

blocks.zh: 強制輸出（必須產出決策/行動）：
blocks.en: Mandatory outputs (decisions/actions must be produced):

blocks.zh: 維持 QMS 適用性、充分性、有效性所需的改善措施
blocks.en: Improvements needed to maintain the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the QMS

blocks.zh: 與顧客要求相關的產品改善
blocks.en: Improvement of product related to customer requirements

blocks.zh: 資源需求
blocks.en: Resource needs

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §4.2.3 器材檔案（Medical Device File）——新要求解說
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §4.2.3 Medical Device File: Explanation of a New Requirement

blocks.zh: 這是舊版 QSR 中沒有直接對應概念的新要求。「器材檔案」不是一份文件，而是一個索引或資料夾架構，彙整與特定器材或器材系列相關的所有 QMS 文件與記錄：
blocks.en: This is a new requirement with no direct equivalent in the former QSR. The "medical device file" is not a single document but an index or folder structure that compiles all QMS documents and records related to a specific device or device family:

blocks.zh: 器材描述、預期用途、標籤
blocks.en: Device description, intended use, and labeling

blocks.zh: 設計規格與測試記錄（DHF 元素）
blocks.en: Design specifications and test records (DHF elements)

blocks.zh: 生產程序與測試程序參考
blocks.en: References to production procedures and test procedures

blocks.zh: 安裝與維護程序（如適用）
blocks.en: Installation and servicing procedures (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 上市後監測要求與記錄
blocks.en: Post-market surveillance requirements and records

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：客戶擁有的器材檔案不一定完整移交給 CDMO。需在 Quality Agreement 中明確哪些文件由誰維護。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: the medical device file owned by the customer is not necessarily handed over to the CDMO in full. The Quality Agreement must specify which documents are maintained by whom.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家歐洲器材公司持有 ISO 13485:2016 認證，並在認證時合法排除了 §7.3 設計開發要求（因為設計由其美國母公司控制）。現在該公司想要在美國直接銷售這些器材。根據 QMSR Appendix A，它需要採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: A European device company holds ISO 13485:2016 certification and legitimately excluded the §7.3 design and development requirements at the time of certification (because the design is controlled by its US parent company). The company now wants to sell these devices directly in the US. Under QMSR Appendix A, what steps does it need to take?

blocks.zh: 一個植入式心臟節律器（Implantable Cardiac Pacemaker）的預期使用壽命為 15 年。根據 FDA QMSR 記錄保存要求，Device History Records 至少需保存多少年？從什麼時間點起算？
blocks.en: An implantable cardiac pacemaker has an expected lifetime of 15 years. Under the FDA QMSR record retention requirements, for at least how many years must the Device History Records be retained, and from what point is the period counted?

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — CDMO 合規缺口分析框架
blocks.en: Commentary — CDMO Compliance Gap Analysis Framework

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 → QMSR 轉換的五步驟框架
blocks.en: Five-Step Framework for Transitioning from ISO 13485 to the QMSR

blocks.zh: 對任何已有 ISO 13485 認證、想要進入美國市場的製造商，建議用以下框架進行缺口分析：
blocks.en: For any manufacturer that already holds ISO 13485 certification and wants to enter the US market, we recommend using the following framework for gap analysis:

blocks.zh:
Step 1：設計控制審查
確認你的 ISO 13485 認證範圍是否包含 §7.3。若排除，評估 FDA 是否仍然要求（取決於你在美國的實際角色）。與美國客戶在 Quality Agreement 中明確設計控制責任歸屬。
blocks.en:
Step 1: Design control review
Confirm whether the scope of your ISO 13485 certification includes §7.3. If it is excluded, assess whether FDA still requires it (depending on your actual role in the US). Clearly allocate design control responsibility with your US customer in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh:
Step 2：投訴程序升級
對照 §820.198 的具體要求，更新投訴程序以包含 MDR 評估步驟，並確認記錄格式包含所有必填欄位。
blocks.en:
Step 2: Complaint procedure upgrade
Compare against the specific requirements of §820.198, update the complaint procedure to include an MDR evaluation step, and confirm that the record format contains all required fields.

blocks.zh:
Step 3：MDR 觸發機制建立
在 QMS 中建立明確路徑：「不符合事項/投訴 → MDR 申報評估 → 按時提交」，並設定計時機制（30天/5天）。
blocks.en:
Step 3: Establish the MDR trigger mechanism
Build a clear pathway in the QMS: "nonconformity/complaint → MDR reporting evaluation → submit on time," and set up a timing mechanism (30 days/5 days).

blocks.zh:
Step 4：英文記錄可取得性確認
確認所有在 FDA 查廠時可能被要求的記錄（DHR、CAPA、投訴、管理審查）均有英文版本可提供。
blocks.en:
Step 4: Confirm availability of English-language records
Confirm that all records that FDA may request during an inspection (DHR, CAPA, complaints, management review) can be provided in English.

blocks.zh:
Step 5：記錄保存期限複查
依照 FDA 公式重新計算每個產品類型的最低保存期限，更新記錄管控程序。
blocks.en:
Step 5: Re-check record retention periods
Recalculate the minimum retention period for each product type using the FDA formula, and update the record control procedure.

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement 是 CDMO 合規的關鍵工具
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement Is a Key Compliance Tool for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 與 OEM 的合作關係中，Quality Agreement（品質協議）是劃分 §820.4 合規責任的核心文件。它應明確：
blocks.en: In the relationship between a CDMO and an OEM, the Quality Agreement is the core document for allocating §820.4 compliance responsibilities. It should clearly specify:

blocks.zh: 誰持有 Device Master Record（DMR）
blocks.en: Who holds the Device Master Record (DMR)

blocks.zh: 誰負責設計控制（Design Controls）
blocks.en: Who is responsible for design controls

blocks.zh: 誰負責接收和評估美國市場投訴
blocks.en: Who receives and evaluates US market complaints

blocks.zh: 誰負責 MDR 申報
blocks.en: Who is responsible for MDR submissions

blocks.zh: 誰負責 Part 806 矯正移除報告
blocks.en: Who is responsible for Part 806 correction and removal reports

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 查廠時各方的配合義務
blocks.en: Each party's obligation to cooperate during a US FDA inspection

blocks.zh: 未在 Quality Agreement 中明確這些責任，是 CDMO 面臨 FDA 查廠時最大的風險之一。
blocks.en: Failing to define these responsibilities in the Quality Agreement is one of the biggest risks a CDMO faces during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠準備——§820.4 相關文件清單
blocks.en: FDA Inspection Preparation: Document Checklist Related to §820.4

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員（Investigator）在審查 §820.4 合規性時通常會要求：
blocks.en: When reviewing §820.4 compliance, FDA investigators will typically request:

blocks.zh: 品質手冊（Quality Manual）——展示 QMS 架構
blocks.en: Quality Manual: demonstrates the QMS architecture

blocks.zh: 文件管控程序書（Document Control SOP）
blocks.en: Document Control SOP

blocks.zh: 記錄管控程序書（Record Control SOP）
blocks.en: Record Control SOP

blocks.zh: 管理審查程序書及最近一次審查記錄
blocks.en: Management review procedure and the most recent review records

blocks.zh: 組織架構圖及職責說明
blocks.en: Organization chart and description of responsibilities

blocks.zh: 管理代表任命書
blocks.en: Management representative appointment letter

blocks.zh: 人員訓練記錄及能力評估記錄
blocks.en: Personnel training records and competence evaluation records

blocks.zh: 投訴處理程序書（符合 §820.198）
blocks.en: Complaint handling procedure (compliant with §820.198)

blocks.zh: 設施維護記錄（廠房、設備）
blocks.en: Facility maintenance records (buildings, equipment)

blocks.zh: 作業環境監測記錄
blocks.en: Work environment monitoring records

blocks.zh: 重點摘要
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: §820.4 + ISO 13485 整合的核心要點
blocks.en: Core Points of §820.4 + ISO 13485 Integration

blocks.zh: §820.4 是全部的起點：一旦公司被認定為 21 CFR Part 820 的「manufacturer」，就必須完全符合 ISO 13485:2016（具法律強制力）加上 Appendix A 的 FDA 附加要求。
blocks.en: §820.4 is the starting point for everything: once a company is deemed a "manufacturer" under 21 CFR Part 820, it must fully comply with ISO 13485:2016 (legally enforceable) plus the additional FDA requirements in Appendix A.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §4（文件體系）：理解「管制文件 vs 記錄」的根本差異。文件可修改但需走變更控制；記錄不得修改，依保存期限管理。FDA 記錄保存要求：產品壽命 + 2 年（或商業出廠後至少 2 年，取較長者）。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §4 (documentation system): understand the fundamental difference between controlled documents and records. Documents may be changed but must go through change control; records must not be altered and are managed according to their retention period. FDA record retention requirement: product lifetime + 2 years (or at least 2 years after commercial release, whichever is longer).

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §5（管理責任）：管理審查必須涵蓋法定輸入並產出法定決議記錄。缺少任何一項強制輸入，即構成不符合。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §5 (management responsibility): the management review must cover the required inputs and produce records of the required decisions. Missing any one mandatory input constitutes a nonconformity.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §6（資源）：人員能力管理需有完整四步驟循環（確定需求→提供訓練→評估有效性→維護記錄）；工作環境要求需文件化。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §6 (resources): personnel competence management needs the complete four-step cycle (determine needs → provide training → evaluate effectiveness → maintain records); work environment requirements must be documented.

blocks.zh: Appendix A 五大差距：設計控制不可排除、§820.198 投訴細節要求、MDR 觸發程序、Part 806 連結、英文記錄可取得性。
blocks.en: The five Appendix A gaps: design controls cannot be excluded, detailed §820.198 complaint requirements, the MDR trigger procedure, the Part 806 link, and availability of English-language records.

blocks.zh: CDMO 特別注意：透過 Quality Agreement 明確設計控制責任歸屬，是 CDMO 在 QMSR 框架下最重要的合規保護措施。
blocks.en: Special note for CDMOs: clearly allocating design control responsibility through the Quality Agreement is the most important compliance safeguard for a CDMO under the QMSR framework.

blocks.zh: 下一節預告
blocks.en: Preview of the Next Section

blocks.zh: Section 3 將進入 ISO 13485 §7：產品實現（Product Realization），涵蓋設計開發（§7.3）的完整要求——包括設計輸入、設計輸出、設計審查、設計驗證與確效，以及設計轉移。這是 FDA Appendix A 中最重要的強制要求，也是無菌器材 CDMO 最複雜的合規領域之一。
blocks.en: Section 3 moves on to ISO 13485 §7: Product Realization, covering the complete requirements of design and development (§7.3), including design inputs, design outputs, design review, design verification and validation, and design transfer. This is the most important mandatory requirement in FDA Appendix A and one of the most complex compliance areas for a sterile device CDMO.
